entries.answer: The network is ExampleHouse-Guest and the password is on the card by the front door.
Checkout is at 11 AM. Please start the dishwasher and leave the keys on the kitchen counter.
Fresh towels and sheets are in the hall closet next to the bathroom.
Park in the driveway, on the left side. Street parking is fine after 6 PM.
Quiet hours are 10 PM to 8 AM. No smoking indoors and no parties, please.
Pods are under the sink. Press Normal, then Start; it takes about two hours.
Detergent is on the shelf above it. Use the Quick Wash setting.
Example owner-only note: replace this with your own, or delete it. Guests never hear owner entries.
